summary: Phase Features Backend Testing - 33/33 tests passed (100%). All 8 major platform features tested: Community Feed, Group Sessions, ETA-weighted Matching, Instant Match, Progress Tracking, Virtual Instant Match, and Trainer Tools (Workout Plans, Session Notes, Client Progress). Fixed datetime comparison bug in instant match status endpoint. All endpoints working correctly with proper role-based access control.

bugs_fixed.issue: TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes
bugs_fixed.fix: Added timezone awareness check before comparing datetime fields (currentOfferExpiresAt, expiresAt)

frontend_issues.note: Frontend testing SKIPPED as requested - backend-only testing for React Native/Expo app

critical_code_review_comments: All 25 endpoints tested and verified working
Role-based access control properly enforced (trainer vs trainee roles)
ETA-weighted composite scoring working with 40% ETA, 20% rating, 15% sessions, 10% price, 10% boost, 5% responsiveness
Instant match cascade mechanism implemented (15-second accept window)
Group sessions support Stripe payments (may fail on join if Stripe not configured)
Progress tracking auto-calculates from session data and supports trainer-submitted metrics
Trainer tools properly scoped to trainer role only
seed_data_creation: Updated trainer profile with location (33.749, -84.388 Atlanta) to enable location-based searches and instant matching
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 major platform features verified working. Test trainer profile has location set for instant matching.
